officialSources.scopeEvidence: The current public viewer configuration identifies the production WFS as an Addis Ababa service: cityCode AA-ADS, cityBrandName Addis, and an Addis Ababa website/configuration. This does not establish coverage in Naqamte or Oromia.

requests.outcome: Viewer loaded. Current JavaScript/configuration references the public GeoServer WFS and Addis-only city configuration.
Configuration exposed gsUrl/wfsUrl, layer v_1_registered_parcel, workspace ncrprs_cadaster, cityCode AA-ADS and Addis branding; no Naqamte/Oromia coverage claim.

nativeIdentity.evidence: Addis control response contained uniqueparcelid AA000010100005 and also a generated GeoServer feature id. The field is not adopted for Naqamte because no Naqamte feature was returned.
